entries.description: TurboVAEDDecoder3d __init__ raises IndexError because inject_noise tuple default has 4 elements but needs 5 (accessed at indices 0..4 for mid block + 4 up blocks)
entries.root_cause: inject_noise default tuple had 4 elements (matching len(block_out_channels)) but needs len(block_out_channels)+1 = 5 because inject_noise[0] is used for mid block and inject_noise[i+1] for each up block
entries.fix_applied: Changed inject_noise default from (False,False,False,False) to (False,False,False,False,False) in both the constructor signature (line 585) and the factory setdefault (line 783)

entries.description: Models and prompt templates not loaded at startup in HomeViewModel.cs
entries.root_cause: Bug 1: PromptTemplates.json was defined as a MauiAsset (not EmbeddedResource) in the .csproj, so GetManifestResourceStream returned null silently, and the catch fallback never fired. Bug 2: Constructor never called CheckModelStatusAsync(), so IsModelDownloaded stayed false at startup.
entries.fix_applied: Added <EmbeddedResource> for PromptTemplates.json in .csproj; removed dead templatesPath variable; extracted CheckModelStatusAtStartup() and called it from constructor; refactored CheckModelStatusAsync() to delegate to the shared method.
